# TPC-Havoc Q14_v5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH qualified_lineitems AS (SELECT l_partkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) AND l_shipdate < CAST('1995-09-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH'), promo_parts AS (SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_type LIKE 'PROMO%'), revenue_calculation AS (SELECT CASE WHEN NOT pp.p_partkey IS NULL THEN ql.l_extendedprice * (1 - ql.l_discount) ELSE 0 END AS promo_revenue, ql.l_extendedprice * (1 - ql.l_discount) AS total_revenue FROM qualified_lineitems AS ql JOIN part AS p ON ql.l_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN promo_parts AS pp ON ql.l_partkey = pp.p_partkey) SELECT 100.00 * SUM(promo_revenue) / SUM(total_revenue) AS promo_revenue FROM revenue_calculation
```
